## Guardrails (accepted by the owner, 2026-11-20)
The agent never posts a stand-in review, resolves a review thread, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. description:
## Problem
TPC-DI seed-corpus cells are not official, so `.github/workflows/seed-corpus.yml` never passes `--seed`; runs rely on the default in `benchbox/core/tpcdi/config.py` and the bundles record no seed. The three ClickHouse Local bundles from run 3096 (#4317) record `platform.version: "unknown"`.

## Change
Record in the bundle the data-generation seed actually used, read from the generator configuration (`get_generation_config()`); the CLI's `--seed` is documented as the seed for query parameter generation and may not reach TPC-DI data generation. Change the workflow command only if recording is impossible without it, with the value shown to the owner. Find why ClickHouse Local's version is recorded as unknown and record the real version. Existing bundles are not rewritten.

## Decision gates
The optional bundle field `benchmark.data_generation_seed` is approved (see context). No digest of an existing bundle may change. No re-run of hosted seed cells without owner approval (it is a workflow dispatch). The engine-version half merged in #4400.

## Verification rubric
Pass: a local SF 0.01 TPC-DI run through the same command line as the workflow cell produces a bundle with the seed recorded; a ClickHouse Local run records a concrete version; workflow lint and the seed-corpus workflow tests pass.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
